translations.web: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.
translations.bsb: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make
translations.asv: Thou shalt not plant thee an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the altar of Jehovah thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
